race.description: Jockeys Celebration Day C,G&E Mdn Plate
race.comment: CHIP'N'DALE (4) is a two-start maiden who returned good figures on resumption with an eye catching fourth over 1013m at Sale. Has scope for further improvement and is a great chance to break through over this journey. WISER (7) is back after a break of five months. Failed to see the 1400m out with a battling seventh over 1400m at this track last February. Has trialled twice for this and the cross-over nose band goes on. Winning player. BRAZEN MARTINI (2) drifted back in the small field when he returned from a let-up with a plugging third over 1000m at Mildura. Fitter now and worth thought. I'VE FORGOTTEN (9) average performance in his debut run at Narrandera last start after eight trials. Well placed and fitter gets a chance to feature.
